source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Ecuador 2026 World Cup Home Kit
source.quote: The Ecuador 2026 World Cup Home Kit, made by Marathon, has been officially revealed.
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The same article lists every mark on the yellow home shirt: 'The FEF crest sits on the left chest, while the Marathon logo is positioned on the right', and 'Below the rear collar, the phrase “Soñar Trascender y Hacer Historia” appears'; 'HIDROTEC' branding along the hem is Marathon's own fabric mark. No commercial sponsor named anywhere on the shirt. The FEF's federation-level sponsors (e.g. Banco Pichincha, Supermaxi) appear in activations and training wear, not on the match shirt.

summary: Marathon's yellow 2026 home shirt carries no commercial sponsors — only the FEF crest, the Marathon logo, the motto 'Soñar Trascender y Hacer Historia' below the back collar and Marathon's HIDROTEC fabric mark on the hem (Football Shirt Culture's launch description).
